request.text: Check the weather in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, for 4:00 p.m. local time on Friday, September 4, 2026. Separately, remind me at 6:10 p.m. New York time on Thursday, September 3, 2026, to download the offline map; do not set that reminder in Dubai time.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up the weather in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, for 4:00 p.m. Dubai local time on September 4, 2026.
Create a reminder to download the offline map at 6:10 p.m. New York time on September 3, 2026, explicitly not in Dubai time.

semantic_facts: The weather lookup must use Dubai, United Arab Emirates, at 4:00 p.m. Dubai local time on September 4, 2026.
The separate offline-map reminder must use 6:10 p.m. New York time on September 3, 2026; the weather location and timezone do not govern the reminder.
Both responsibilities must be represented without merging their dates, places, times, or output modes.
forbidden_claims: The reminder is scheduled in Dubai time or inherits the weather lookup's date or time.
The weather lookup is assigned the reminder's New York timezone or September 3 date.
The assistant claims either operation completed without its corresponding trusted capability evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Arguments from adjacent responsibilities bleed across capability calls, causing a reminder to inherit a weather location, date, or timezone.
Multiple catalog-backed outcomes are collapsed so that one requested operation or its decisive constraints disappear.
